offering_description.value: Provides IoT connectivity services, including cellular connectivity management, SIM and eSIM subscriptions, and IoT software platforms, plus asset-tracking and fleet-management solutions. Sells to enterprises and IoT device makers, delivered through a cloud platform and carrier partnerships.

primary_products.value: IoT SIM cards and eSIMs; asset-tracking devices; IoT routers and gateways; telematics hardware

primary_services.value: IoT connectivity management; cellular data connectivity; IoT software platform; fleet and asset tracking services; device and network consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: IoT device makers, enterprises, fleet operators, healthcare and industrial companies, and resellers; B2G: Public sector and municipal customers using fleet tracking and connected devices

end_markets.value: transportation and logistics; healthcare; utilities and energy; industrial and smart cities; security and retail

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring connectivity and platform subscriptions per connected device; transaction or usage fees: data usage charges on cellular connections; product sales: IoT hardware such as trackers, routers and SIMs; service fees: professional services and consulting
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: cloud connectivity management platform for enterprise IoT deployments; service provider: buys network access from carriers and resells managed IoT connectivity to enterprises; brand owner: markets tracking and telematics hardware made by contract manufacturers
value_chain_position.category: software / platform; service provider; brand owner

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, and other international markets via carrier partnerships

specialization.value: related lines: IoT connectivity, IoT software platforms, and asset-tracking and fleet solutions

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: enterprise sales teams selling to large IoT customers; partners / resellers: channel partners, system integrators and carrier partners; online: online ordering of SIMs and devices

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Telecom rules, spectrum and carrier agreements, data privacy, and device certification such as FCC

notes: Details on current segments (e.g., after any ownership changes) may be incomplete; KORE was reported to be taken private in 2025-2026.
